lemmas.primary_translation: for a sailing vessel, have the wind enter the sail from the front; for a motor vessel, put the engine in reverse

definitions.text: om seilfartøy: få vinden forfra inn i seilet
definitions.translation: for a sailing vessel: have the wind enter the sail from the front

examples.no: skipperen slo bakk og unngikk kollisjon
examples.en: the skipper let the wind enter the sail from the front and avoided a collision

definitions.text: om motorfartøy: sette motoren i revers
definitions.translation: for a motor vessel: put the engine in reverse
